# FreeResourceAtlas

> A directory of software, apps, games, public projects and learning resources with source links and explicit access/review labels.

English is the default. Interface language suggestions are optional; untranslated resource content remains visibly English.

A discovered listing is not automatically reviewed, free, secure, tested or indexed. Follow the original provider for current terms and availability. Paid games and limited free plans are labeled.

Native template files are not published until Storage upload and distribution review succeed. No ranking, security, income or compatibility guarantee is made. This document describes the website; it is not an indexing or AI-citation mechanism.
